# Blue Star Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **complete**

Blue Star Limited (CIN L28920MH1949PLC006870) is an Indian listed HVAC/refrigeration and MEP contracting company, confirmed as the correct entity (BSE 500067, NSE BLUESTARCO). Section 135 CSR is applicable. Found FY2024-25 statutory CSR figures (obligation Rs 7.04cr, spend Rs 7.39cr, excess Rs 0.35cr, unspent Rs 0.13cr transferred for a CII Foundation project) via a secondary CSR-news source; BRSR filings for FY2022-23, FY2023-24 and FY2024-25 confirmed Section 135 applicability and gave project-level beneficiary counts, implementing themes (Sitare, NAPS, Mohan T Advani Centennial Scholarship) and named locations (Palghar, Wada, Hingoli district, Himachal Pradesh/Kala Amb, Madhya Pradesh, Sri City, Chennai, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Thanjavur). Blue Star Foundation (est. 1982) is the company's philanthropic arm/charitable trust, recorded as its own entity. Did not find MCA CSR-1 registration numbers, PAN, a published CSR/grants mailbox, project-level rupee amounts by sector/district for FY2022-23/FY2023-24, or any open RFP/partner-with-us call.

Website: https://www.bluestarindia.com

- open RFPs/partner-with-us pages
